statement: Represent the flow path of pipe and duct networks with analytical segments that carry flow and pressure-drop parameters, can be tagged or scheduled, and are shown with visibility controls.
superiority: Expose segments as a first-class query layer for external solvers.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-14: feature found documented in Revit 2027 help during the verification pass; not in the original register Acceptance sketch: Compute a network, tag an analytical segment, and verify the tag shows its flow and pressure drop.

statement: Define circuit naming schemes from parameters, prefixes, suffixes and separators, then assign a default scheme for the project or a scheme per panel.
superiority: Preview resulting names live for existing panels.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-14: feature found documented in Revit 2027 help during the verification pass; not in the original register Acceptance sketch: Create a scheme with prefix and panel name, assign it to a panel, and verify new circuit numbers follow it.

statement: Click a series of points to build a connected run of fabrication parts automatically from the current service and palette.
superiority: Allow the same point-click routing for design-intent MEP with collision avoidance.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-14: feature found documented in Revit 2027 help during the verification pass; not in the original register Acceptance sketch: Click four points and verify a connected run of parts with elbows is created.

statement: Show on-canvas cues for connector number, type and size while placing or selecting fabrication parts and design elements.

source.ref: Improved Modeling Experience with In-Canvas Connector Controls

superiority: Make connector cues interactive so a size can be edited in place.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-14: Revit 2027 What’s New feature with no matching row in the original register Acceptance sketch: Select a fabrication part and confirm each connector displays its number, type and size.

statement: Set sizing criteria for a selected duct by friction, velocity or aspect ratio with tolerance sliders and size limits, list the sizes that qualify and apply a chosen one.
superiority: Offer cost and weight ranking beside each candidate size.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-14: Revit 2027 What’s New feature with no matching row in the original register Acceptance sketch: Size a duct run for a velocity limit and confirm the listed sizes all satisfy it.

statement: Set sizing criteria for a selected pipe by friction and/or velocity with tolerance sliders and size limits, list qualifying sizes and apply one.
superiority: Rank the qualifying pipe sizes by cost and noise.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-14: Revit 2027 What’s New feature with no matching row in the original register Acceptance sketch: Size a water pipe for a friction limit and verify the applied size meets it.

statement: Add a riser through a dedicated Create Riser button while placing duct, pipe, cable tray or conduit.

source.ref: Improved Usability for Creating a Riser

superiority: Infer the riser from the next picked level.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-14: Revit 2027 What’s New feature with no matching row in the original register Acceptance sketch: Start a pipe run and create a riser to a second level in one gesture.
